data.name: ExportVideo
data.comment: The amber button in the command bar (Ctrl+E).

data.name: ExportingButton
data.comment: The same button, dimmed, while an export runs.

data.name: Exporting
data.comment: The caption over the file name while the export runs.

data.name: RunningNameFormat
data.comment: A screen reader's name for the running export's title, where the focus lands as the export starts: {0} the file name.

data.name: PercentFormat
data.comment: The large percent: {0} the whole percent.

data.name: ProgressName
data.comment: The progress bar's name for a screen reader.

data.name: GettingReady
data.comment: Before the first frame is written.

data.name: EstimatingTimeLeft
data.comment: Frames are being written but the speed is not known yet.

data.name: Finishing
data.comment: Every frame is in; the file is being completed.

data.name: TimeLeftSecondsFormat
data.comment: Time left under a minute: {0} the seconds.

data.name: TimeLeftMinutesFormat
data.comment: Time left from a minute, on the minute: {0} the minutes.

data.name: TimeLeftMinutesHalfFormat
data.comment: Time left from a minute, with a half minute: {0} the minutes.

data.name: FrameLabel
data.comment: The label of the frame count row.

data.name: FramesFormat
data.comment: The frame count: {0} the frames written, {1} the total, both zero-padded to the total's width ("0312 of 0742").

data.name: SpeedLabel
data.comment: The label of the speed row.

data.name: SpeedFormat
data.comment: The speed: {0} photos per second, one decimal.

data.name: SpeedMeasuring
data.comment: The speed before it has been measured.

data.name: OutputLabel
data.comment: The label of the output row.

data.name: OutputSummaryFormat
data.comment: The output summary: {0} the resolution ("4K"), {1} the codec ("H.264"), {2} the quality ("High").

data.name: MinimizeHint
data.value: You can minimize 10Lapse. The export keeps going and Windows tells you when it's done.
data.comment: The hint under the numbers.

data.name: CancelExport
data.comment: The button that stops the export.

data.name: RenderingFrameFormat
data.comment: The label over the preview while the export runs: {0} the frame being written, zero-padded ("0313").

data.name: ReadyFormat
data.comment: The finished state's title and Narrator's announcement: {0} the file name ("Harbor sunset.mp4").

data.name: ReadySummaryFormat
data.comment: The summary under it: {0} the length ("24.7 s"), {1} the resolution ("4K"), {2} the codec, {3} the file size ("173 MB").

data.name: ExportedInLabel
data.comment: The label of the time the export took.

data.name: SavedToLabel
data.comment: The label of the folder.

data.name: SavedToFormat
data.comment: The folder, shortened to its last two names: {0} the parent folder, {1} the folder ("Videos › 10Lapse").

data.name: Play
data.comment: The accent button: plays the video in the preview from frame one.

data.name: PlayName
data.comment: Its name for a screen reader.

data.name: ShowInFolder
data.comment: Opens File Explorer on the video.

data.name: BackToEditing
data.comment: Back to the inspector.

data.name: Cancelled
data.value: Export cancelled. The unfinished file was removed.
data.comment: The InfoBar once a cancelled export's unfinished file is gone.

data.name: CancelledFileLeft
data.value: Export cancelled. The unfinished file couldn't be removed yet, so 10Lapse removes it the next time it starts.
data.comment: The InfoBar when a cancelled export's unfinished file could not be removed yet.

data.name: EditsWait
data.value: The project can't change while the video exports. Wait for it to finish, or cancel the export.
data.comment: An edit tried while the export runs (a removal, a move, an import, a new project).

data.name: ImportStillRunning
data.value: Photos are still being added. Export once they're all in.
data.comment: Export tried while photos are still being added.

data.name: ChangedDuringDialog
data.value: The export didn't start because the project or its output changed while the Save dialog was open. Choose Export video again.
data.comment: The Save dialog was answered, but the project, its output or the screen changed while it was open.

data.name: PremiereCantPlay
data.value: The video was saved, but 10Lapse couldn't play it here. Open it with Show in folder to check it.
data.comment: The finished video saved, but the preview can't play it (a codec Windows lacks, say).

data.name: CloseTitle
data.comment: The question when the window closes during an export.

data.name: CloseMessage
data.value: The video isn't finished yet. 10Lapse stops the export and removes the unfinished file.
data.comment: What closing does.

data.name: CloseConfirm
data.comment: Closes the window.

data.name: CloseCancel
data.comment: Keeps the window and the export.

data.name: FileTypeName
data.comment: The Save dialog's file type.

data.name: StartedFormat
data.comment: Narrator, as the export starts: {0} the file name.

data.name: ProgressAnnouncementFormat
data.comment: Narrator, at most every ten percent: {0} the percent.

data.name: FailedAnnouncement
data.comment: Narrator, when the export fails (the InfoBar says why).

data.name: FinishingAnnouncement
data.comment: Narrator, once every frame is written and the file is being completed.

data.name: FailedNotificationFormat
data.value: {0} couldn't be exported. Open 10Lapse to see why.
data.comment: The notification when an export in the background failed: {0} the file name.

data.name: KeepAwakeReasonFormat
data.comment: What powercfg /requests shows next to 10Lapse while a video is written. {0} the file name ("Harbor sunset.mp4").

data.name: ExportKeys
data.comment: The Export button's shortcut as a screen reader names it (its accelerator key). The key E is fixed in code; translate only "Control", as Windows names that key in the language ("Strg+E" in German).
